rows.label: UEFA Champions League
rows.description: European association football tournament
rows.hook: crowns the best club side on the continent, with its anthem sung before every match

rows.label: Ballon d'Or
rows.description: annual association football award
rows.hook: hands a golden ball to the best individual player of the year, chosen by a vote of journalists

rows.label: Laver Cup
rows.description: tennis competition
rows.hook: pits a team of Europeans against a team from the rest of the globe, with stars as teammates instead of rivals

rows.label: EFL Cup
rows.description: English association football competition
rows.hook: is the second-tier knockout trophy of English clubs, once named after a milk or a soft drink sponsor

rows.label: FA Cup
rows.description: annual knockout football competition
rows.hook: is the oldest national knockout competition on Earth, where small clubs can beat giants

rows.label: FIFA Club World Cup
rows.description: association football tournament for clubs
rows.hook: gathers the champion clubs of every continent in a single tournament to find the best on the planet

rows.label: AFC Asian Cup
rows.description: international association football tournament run by the Asian Football Confederation
rows.hook: crowns the best national side on the largest continent, held every four years

rows.label: Davis Cup
rows.description: annual international team competition in men's tennis
rows.hook: is a long-running annual contest where nations send teams to battle in best-of-five rubbers on court

rows.label: Heisman Trophy
rows.description: annual award for outstanding college football player
rows.hook: gives a bronze statue of a stiff-arming runner to the best college player of the year

rows.label: Africa Cup of Nations
rows.description: African association football tournament for men's national teams
rows.hook: crowns the best national side on the continent and is held every two years in different host countries

rows.label: Ryder Cup
rows.description: team-based golf competition between European and American professionals
rows.hook: sends twelve pros from each side of the Atlantic to battle for a small gold trophy every two years

rows.label: Indian Premier League
rows.description: professional cricket league in India
rows.hook: is a glitzy franchise competition with city-owned teams, auctioned stars and a short, loud season

rows.label: Copa América
rows.description: South American association football tournament for men's national teams
rows.hook: is the oldest continental national-team tournament on Earth, with Brazil and Argentina as the usual favourites

rows.label: Copa Libertadores
rows.description: South American association football tournament for clubs
rows.hook: is the top prize for the best club sides of the continent where Brazil and Argentina rule

rows.label: Stanley Cup
rows.description: championship trophy awarded annually in the National Hockey League
rows.hook: is a silver chalice with names engraved on its bands, hoisted and drunk from by the winning team

rows.label: Billie Jean King Cup
rows.description: international team competition in women's tennis
rows.hook: is the women's equivalent of a famous team competition, once named after the Federation's own title

rows.label: Copa del Rey
rows.description: Spanish association football tournament
rows.hook: is the knockout competition of Spain, where the final is held on neutral ground in front of a royal

rows.label: NBA Most Valuable Player Award
rows.description: award
rows.hook: goes each season to the top performer on the hardwood, chosen by sportswriters and broadcasters

rows.label: America's Cup
rows.description: sailing race trophy
rows.hook: is the oldest trophy in international sport, held by one nation for 132 years in a row

rows.label: CONCACAF Gold Cup
rows.description: international football tournament in North America
rows.hook: crowns the best national side in North America and the Caribbean, with Mexico and the United States dominant

rows.label: ICC Champions Trophy
rows.description: One-Day International (ODI) cricket tournament organised by the International Cricket Council (ICC)
rows.hook: is a quadrennial one-day tournament among the top eight nations, nicknamed the mini version of a bigger event

rows.label: Cy Young Award
rows.description: Major League Baseball award given annually to the best pitcher in each league
rows.hook: goes to the best pitcher in each league every season, named after a hurler with 511 wins

rows.label: FA Community Shield
rows.description: association football competition in England

rows.label: The Ashes
rows.description: Test cricket series played between Australia and England, the oldest known cricket league
rows.hook: is a famous little urn said to hold burnt remains of a bail, fought over by two old rivals

rows.label: DFB-Pokal
rows.description: cup for German knockout football cup comptetion held BV annually
rows.hook: is the knockout trophy of Germany, with a final always held in the capital's Olympic Stadium

rows.label: MLS Cup
rows.description: championship match of Major League Soccer
rows.hook: is decided in a single playoff final to name the champion of the top American and Canadian circuit

rows.label: Coppa Italia
rows.description: annual domestic cup of Italian football
rows.hook: is the national knockout trophy contested by clubs in the boot-shaped peninsula

rows.label: FIFA World Cup Trophy
rows.description: award for victors for the FIFA World Cup
rows.hook: is a gold statue of two figures holding up a globe, lifted by the planet's champions

rows.label: Six Nations Championship
rows.description: annual international rugby union competition
rows.hook: is the oldest annual northern-hemisphere tournament, with the Calcutta Cup and Triple Crown as side prizes

rows.label: Grey Cup
rows.description: championship game and trophy of the Canadian Football League
